104	/-! ### Universal constants and fixed problem parameters -/
105	
106	/-- Mass `m` of each particle (electron and positron inertial mass, kg). -/
107	opaque particleMass : ℝ
108	
109	/-- Reduced Planck constant `ℏ` (J·s). -/
110	opaque hbar : ℝ
111	
112	/-- Coulomb constant `k = 1/(4πε₀)` (N·m²·C⁻²). -/
113	opaque coulombK : ℝ
114	
115	/-- Elementary charge magnitude `e`: the electron has charge `−e`, the
116	positron `+e` (C). -/
117	opaque elementaryCharge : ℝ
118	
119	/-- Bohr radius `a₀ = 4πε₀ℏ²/(m e²) = ℏ²/(k·m·e²)` (m).  Opaque on purpose:
120	its defining SI relation to `k, ℏ, m, e` is imposed via
121	`ScalingRegime.bohr_radius_def` so that nothing about the target value can
122	be obtained by unfolding. -/
123	opaque bohrRadius : ℝ
124	
125	/-- Positivity of the constants plus the defining relation of the Bohr
126	radius (`a₀ = ℏ²/(k·m·e²)`, i.e. the page's `a₀ = 4πε₀ℏ²/(m e²)` with

128	structure ScalingRegime : Prop where
129	  particleMass_pos : 0 < particleMass
130	  hbar_pos : 0 < hbar
131	  coulombK_pos : 0 < coulombK
132	  elementaryCharge_pos : 0 < elementaryCharge
133	  bohrRadius_pos : 0 < bohrRadius
134	  bohr_radius_def : bohrRadius = hbar ^ 2 / (coulombK * particleMass * elementaryCharge ^ 2)

137	particle carries angular momentum `μ·ℏ` about the centre of mass. -/
138	def IsAngularMomentumFactor (μ : ℝ) : Prop :=

140

142	def initialSeparationInBohrRadii : ℝ := 100
143	
144	/-- The angular-momentum factor of the bound subquestion T1-B1: `μ = 4`. -/
145	def boundMu : ℝ := 4

148	instant the total energy of the pair is
149	`E = 4 μ²ℏ²/(m r₀²) − k e²/r₀`, which is negative exactly when
150	`4 μ² ℏ² < k m e² r₀`.  `IsBoundMu μ` is the strict version of this
151	inequality together with `0 < μ`.  No closed-form answer is involved. -/
152	def IsBoundMu (μ : ℝ) : Prop :=
153	  IsAngularMomentumFactor μ ∧
154	    4 * μ ^ 2 * hbar ^ 2 <
155	      coulombK * particleMass * elementaryCharge ^ 2 *
156	        (initialSeparationInBohrRadii * bohrRadius)

162	  refine ⟨by norm_num [boundMu, IsAngularMomentumFactor], ?_⟩
163	  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < coulombK * particleMass * elementaryCharge :=

165	  rw [boundMu, initialSeparationInBohrRadii, hR.bohr_radius_def]
166	  field_simp
167	  rw [lt_div_iff₀ hb]
168	  nlinarith [mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hR.hbar_pos) hb]
169

171	`IsBoundMu μ` includes `IsAngularMomentumFactor μ`, i.e. `0 < μ`, so any
172	certified bound factor is nonzero.  Route-independent; carries no numeric
173	target content. -/
174	theorem IsBoundMu.ne_zero {μ : ℝ} (hb : IsBoundMu μ) : μ ≠ 0 :=

180	electron–positron pair with purely electrostatic interaction, with the
181	two-body → one-body (relative coordinate, reduced mass) reduction encoded.
182

184	metres, speeds in m/s.  No field mentions the maximum separation requested

186	structure CoulombPairData (hR : ScalingRegime) where
187	  /-- Reduced inertial mass of the two equal masses (kg). -/
188	  reduced_mass : ℝ
189	  /-- Total angular momentum about the centre of mass, magnitude (J·s). -/
190	  total_angular_momentum : ℝ
191	  /-- Conserved total energy of the isolated system (J). -/
192	  total_energy : ℝ
193	  /-- Initial separation (Fig. 1b), in metres. -/
194	  initial_separation : ℝ
195	  /-- Initial CM-frame speed of each particle (m/s); the velocities are
196	      antiparallel, so the relative speed is `2·initial_speed`. -/
197	  initial_speed : ℝ
198	  /-- Reduced mass of two equal point masses: `μ_red = m/2`. -/
199	  reduced_mass_eq : reduced_mass = particleMass / 2
200	  /-- Fig. 1b readout: `r₀ = 100·a₀`. -/
201	  initial_separation_value :
202	    initial_separation = initialSeparationInBohrRadii * bohrRadius
203	  /-- Angular momentum per particle about the centre of mass is `μ·ℏ`
204	      (given data): each particle orbits at radius `r₀/2` with velocity
205	      perpendicular to its radius vector, so `m v₀ (r₀/2) = μ ℏ`. -/
206	  angular_momentum_per_particle :
207	    particleMass * initial_speed * (initial_separation / 2) = boundMu * hbar
208	  /-- Total angular momentum is the sum of the two equal per-particle
209	      contributions (equal masses, antiparallel velocities ⇒ centre of
210	      mass at the midpoint): `L = 2 μ ℏ`. -/
211	  total_angular_momentum_eq :
212	    total_angular_momentum =
213	      2 * (particleMass * initial_speed * (initial_separation / 2))
214	  /-- Relative-coordinate kinetic energy: the sum of the two Newtonian
215	      kinetic energies equals `(1/2) μ_red v_rel²` with
216	      `v_rel = 2 v₀`. -/
217	  relative_kinetic :
218	    2 * ((1 / 2) * particleMass * initial_speed ^ 2) =
219	      (1 / 2) * reduced_mass * (2 * initial_speed) ^ 2
220	  /-- Coulomb's law: potential energy `U(r) = −k e²/r`; at the transverse
221	      initial instant the total energy is kinetic plus Coulomb. -/
222	  coulomb_law :
223	    total_energy =
224	      2 * ((1 / 2) * particleMass * initial_speed ^ 2) -
225	        coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 / initial_separation
226	  /-- Effective radial law — orbit support (energy + angular-momentum
227	      conservation for the inverse-square attraction, Hint 1 of the
228	      official page): there exists a nonempty set `O` of attained
229	      separations along the orbit, all of positive radius, and along the
230	      trajectory the radial kinetic energy is nonnegative, i.e. the
231	      turning-point quadratic
232	      `Q(r) = E·r² + k e²·r − L²/(2 μ_red)`
233	      is nonnegative at every attained separation `r ∈ O`, with
234	      `Q(r) = 0` exactly at turning points.  The radial kinetic energy is

238	      upper edge, any numeric value beyond the Fig.-1b readout) is

434	theorem turningQuadratic_normalized_eq {hR : ScalingRegime}

444	  have hk : coulombK ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR.coulombK_pos
445	  have he : elementaryCharge ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR.elementaryCharge_pos

472	  -- Explicit initial speed `v₀ = 2ℏ/(25·m·a₀)`.

479	    rw [hv0]

481	    ring
482	  -- Energy value `E = 4ℏ²/(625·m·a₀²) − k·e²/(100·a₀)`.

491	    field_simp [hm, ha]
492	    ring
493	  -- Linear-coefficient match: `k·e² = (25/16)·L²/(2·μ_red·r₀)`.

495	      (D.total_angular_momentum ^ 2 / (2 * D.reduced_mass * D.initial_separation)) := by
496	    rw [hL, D.reduced_mass_eq, hr0, h64]
497	    field_simp [hm, ha]

507	(`CoulombPairData.bound_branch : E < 0`), for every large enough radius

511	subtracted centrifugal term strictly positive. Hence no lawful separation
512	with `0 ≤ q` can reach `k e²/(−E)`, so the radial support is bounded above.

514	conclusion-side content (`orbitBound_T1_B1`). -/
515	theorem quadratic_neg_of_large {hR : ScalingRegime} (D : CoulombPairData hR)
516	    (hm : 0 < D.reduced_mass) {r : ℝ}
517	    (hr : coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 / (-D.total_energy) ≤ r) :
518	    D.turningQuadratic r < 0 := by
519	  have hE : D.total_energy < 0 := D.bound_branch
520	  have hneg : 0 < -D.total_energy := neg_pos.mpr hE
521	  have he : elementaryCharge ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hR.elementaryCharge_pos
522	  have hnum_pos : 0 < coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 :=
523	    mul_pos hR.coulombK_pos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero he)
524	  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos hnum_pos hneg) hr
525	  have hkey : D.total_energy * r + coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
526	    have hmul : coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 ≤ r * (-D.total_energy) := by
527	      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (le_of_lt hneg)

529	    have hcast : D.total_energy * r = -(r * (-D.total_energy)) := by ring
530	    rw [hcast]
531	    nlinarith [hmul]
532	  have hLpos : 0 < D.total_angular_momentum := by
533	    rw [D.total_angular_momentum_eq, D.angular_momentum_per_particle]

543	    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hr_pos) hkey
